name: Notes App
note: A little native app. 'desktop' apps show running when a process named 'processName' (its .exe, without extension) is found.

name: Metrics Dashboard
note: A little web dashboard (Vite/React). 'web' apps show running when their port answers, and the browser opens when it goes live.

name: Habit Tracker
note: A small Python web app. Run a foreground command so its logs stream into the terminal; 'env' injects variables like PORT.

name: CSV Explorer
note: Bundled example: a drop-your-data dashboard for CSV/TSV that auto-profiles any file and renders it. Runs offline, no server, no CDN.

name: JSON Explorer
note: Bundled example: a drop-your-data dashboard for JSON (arrays, nested objects, or maps).

name: JSONL Explorer
note: Bundled example: a drop-your-data dashboard for JSONL / NDJSON (one JSON record per line).

name: YAML Explorer
note: Bundled example: a drop-your-data dashboard for YAML, parsed offline with a vendored js-yaml.

name: TOML Explorer
note: Bundled example: a drop-your-data dashboard for TOML, parsed offline with a vendored j-toml.

name: Excel Explorer
note: Bundled example: a drop-your-data dashboard for Excel .xlsx / .xls, parsed offline with a vendored SheetJS.

name: CLI Script
note: Runs a script and keeps an interactive shell open in 'cwd'. Use the unquoted '-NoExit -Command <tokens>' form; leave off '-Command ...' for a plain shell.

name: Docs Dashboard
note: A self-contained HTML dashboard. 'static' apps with only a 'url' just open it in the browser (no terminal).

name: Moonpool Docs
note: Bundled example: an offline Markdown docs browser hosting Moonpool's own help. {MP_HOME} resolves to Moonpool's folder, so the same entry also works in a portable bundle.
